, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to eat sausages. One day, she was very hungry, but she could not find her sausages.
Sue asked her mom, "Mom, have you seen my sausages?" Her mom said, "No, I did not." Sue was very sad. She asked her mom, "Where is my sausages?" Her mom said, "I put them by the big stove."
Sue went to her room and started to look for her sausages. She looked in her room, but she could not find them. Sue felt very sad. She started to cry. In the end, Sue could not find her sausages anywhere. She was very sad and missed her mom very much.

Lucy and her friends went to the park to find more gems. They walked and walked, but they could not find them. Lucy felt ashamed that she could not find the gems. Then, a little bird flew down and said, "Lucy, you should not play with gems. They are not for us."
Lucy was sad, but she listened to her friends. She went home and told them about the gem. Her friends told her that the gems were very special and they should be careful. Lucy felt sorry and promised to be more careful next time.
The moral of the story is to ask before taking something that doesn't belong to us, like something that belongs to others.
